articles.summary: Moneywise: The US dollar dropped 10% over the past year. Trump thinks 'it's great.' But here's what it really means for your money. As the dollar fell, the consumer price index rose over the first year of Trump's second term, with a basket of goods costing 2.7% more by the end of 2025.
